document.title: test(bench): record the Vita baseline at fdd0f22
document.summary: The committed Vita benchmark baseline moves from `4202f0d` to `fdd0f22`, copied byte for byte from a clean Vita run as `scripts/bench.sh --update-baseline` would.
document.why: The last perf PRs (#127–#130, #133) only recorded Vita3K baselines, so the Vita baseline still described `4202f0d`. [Máté asked](source:s1) to update it to current `main`.

sources.label: Claude Code session · Oct 26
sources.gist: Record the Vita baseline from the existing clean run of main at fdd0f22 without running the device; copy result.json and meta.json as --update-baseline does.

groups.title: Vita baseline data
groups.why: Future `scripts/bench.sh vita` runs compare against this baseline, so it must describe current `main`.
groups.summary: `meta.json` names the run (commit `fdd0f22`, `dirty: false`) whose scenario numbers replace every value in `result.json`.
